name.description: The name identifier for this data cleanup specification.

typeNamesToCleanup.description:
List of entity types that should be cleaned up as part of the workflow.

- This includes facility-related data, reliability assets, sensor relations, events,
  ML-related datasets, models, predictions, alerts, and cases.
- Ensures stale or redundant data is removed before executing new workflow steps.
- Helps maintain data consistency for training, inference, and operational workflows.

title:
Defines the specification for data cleanup within the reliability risk workflow.
- Specifies entity types to be cleaned up before or after workflow execution.
- Supports structured data removal to ensure a consistent state for model training and inference.
- Enables controlled execution through workflow orchestration.
name: ReliabilityOrchestrator.ReliabilityRisk.Spec.DataCleanup
